correctness.rationale: The normalized basis e_n=sqrt(n+1)z^n gives A_nm=2sqrt((n+1)(m+1))/((n+m+1)(n+m+2)) for n+m even, zero otherwise. Weighted Schur row ratios for n>=1, w_n=(n+1)^(-1/2), are bounded strictly below1 by (n+1)log((n+2)/(n+1)) (odd) or (n+1)log((n+3)/(n+2)) (even); hence no nonzero equality in the compressed subspace. A00=1 and A02=sqrt3/6 show a 2x2 compression eigenvalue 3/5+sqrt219/30>1. The coupling vector has norm squared 4log2-1-pi²/6 by partial fractions; the compact rank-two coupling bounds the norm and essential spectrum. A normalized even-degree vector supported on 2i for i=M..M² has Rayleigh quotient tending1, weak limit zero, proving essential norm >=1 (while the compression/coupling gives <=1). The codimension-one variational argument forces exactly one simple eigenvalue above1. Independently checked b² partial sums and M=8,16,32,64 Rayleigh ratios, and analytic constants; finite checks do not substitute for the Weyl-sequence proof.
